steps.title: Digest backbone vectors with HpaI
steps.instruction: Digest the pDONOR‑tagBFP‑PSM‑EGFP (Addgene #100603) and pDONOR‑tagBFP‑PSM‑dTOMATO (Addgene #100604) backbones with 500 U HpaI (NEB Catalog #R0105S) at 37 °C for 4 h to generate two fragments per vector.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 U HpaI (NEB R0105S) to each backbone vector.
Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 04:00:00 (4 h) to obtain two fragments per vector.

steps.title: Assemble HDR arms via NEBuilder HiFi
steps.instruction: Combine the left 1‑kb HDR arm and right 1‑kb HDR arm gene blocks with the corresponding digested fragments from each backbone and perform NEBuilder‱ HiFi DNA Assembly (NEB E5520) to create GBA1‑WT‑pDONOR‑tagBFP‑PSM‑EGFP and GBA1‑WT‑pDONOR‑tagBFP‑PSM‑dTOMATO.

substeps.instruction: Mix the left 1‑kb HDR arm gene block with the two fragments from pDONOR‑tagBFP‑PSM‑EGFP, and the right 1‑kb HDR arm gene block with the two fragments from pDONOR‑tagBFP‑PSM‑dTOMATO.
Perform the assembly using NEBuilder‱ HiFi DNA Assembly kit (NEB Catalog E5520).

steps.title: Obtain PiggyBac transposase vector
steps.instruction: Acquire the excision‑only PiggyBac Transposase expression vector (PB220PA‑1) from SystemBiosciences.

substeps.instruction: Order or otherwise obtain PB220PA‑1 (Excision‑only PiggyBac Transposase expression vector) from SystemBiosciences.

steps.title: PCR‑purify assembled vector fragments
steps.instruction: Purify the two assembled fragments of each vector by PCR purification.

substeps.instruction: Perform PCR purification on the two fragments of both assembled vectors.
